title: Cloak Coin
tagline: An anonymous streak tracker using FHEnix.
description: Cloak Coin is a project designed as an anonymous loyalty or streak program, aimed at providing users with a tool to track their progress while maintaining anonymity. The program functions as a simple gamified streak counter, allowing users to monitor their own progress without revealing identifiable information to others.
how_its_made:
React front end, solidity smart contracts, imported FHEnix in smart contracts.

FHEnix supports encrypted balance and transfer, making the coins cloaked, allowing users to anonymously collect tokens.
